# Lottie Web

Vendored SVG light player, version 5.13.0, from:
https://github.com/airbnb/lottie-web/tree/v5.13.0

Source: `build/player/lottie_light.min.js`.
License: MIT; see `LICENSE.md` in this directory.

The 404 page loads the player and the user-provided animation from local static
files. No external CDN is required by the browser.
